# Pesticide Guide
> An interactive atlas and 2D food map comparing official laboratory pesticide residue monitoring records (USDA PDP, EFSA, CFIA) and Food Compass 2.0 nutrition scores for 69 fruits, vegetables, and legumes across 9 international markets.

Pesticide Guide translates dense government chemical testing records into actionable, transparent consumer guides, helping shoppers decide when to buy organic and how to scientifically wash produce.

## 核心内容
- [Food Map](https://pesticideguide.online/#explorer): Interactive 2D coordinate chart plotting 69 produce items by pesticide residue load and longevity nutrition.
- [Produce Directory](https://pesticideguide.online/#food-index): Full directory of 69 fruit and vegetable profiles with chemical breakdown and market comparison.
- [Shopper's Guide](https://pesticideguide.online/#guide): Scientific advice on prioritizing organic for thin-skinned crops and saving money on thick-skinned produce.

## 常用资源
- [Methodology](https://pesticideguide.online/methodology): Detailed mathematical and toxicological calculation methodology.
- [Official Sources](https://pesticideguide.online/sources): Verified direct links to government chemical monitoring databases.
- [Disclaimer](https://pesticideguide.online/disclaimer): Data limitations, sample size notes, and non-medical advice disclosures.
 - [Privacy Policy](https://pesticideguide.online/privacy): User privacy protection and GDPR/CCPA compliance terms.
 - [Terms of Service](https://pesticideguide.online/terms): Educational platform terms of use and data rights.
 - [Contact](https://pesticideguide.online/contact): Editorial feedback and official dataset correction inquiries.
